ORDINARY_INFRASTRUCTURE.definition: Real ordinary buildings normally constructed or purchased, including Government Plaza ordinary buildings, unique replacements and otherwise-ordinary buildings obtained free. Constructible walls remain ordinary, not excluded merely because not purchasable.
ORDINARY_INFRASTRUCTURE.classification: Explicit semantic classification, not InternalOnly=0 alone or HD Tier>0 alone. Unknown objects do not silently expand ordinary scope. HD taxonomy is evidence/adapter input, not semantic authority.

BUILDING_CURRENT_ELIGIBILITY.definition: Unless explicitly excepted, pillaged buildings are treated as absent: no contribution and no received benefit. Under-construction buildings do not count. Free acquisition does not change ordinary nature.
BUILDING_CURRENT_ELIGIBILITY.history_exception: This current-effect predicate never deletes explicitly permanent Industry learned templates or completed historical facts.

DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.formula: D(district)=min(10,sum(tier(b) for current eligible ordinary buildings in that district))
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.same_tier: Each ordinary building counts, then cap10. Unique replacement uses its tier. Missing lower tiers are not imputed.
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.multiple_districts_same_domain: Use maximum single-district D for that domain, never sum instances.
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.tier_boundary: Do not invent tier for unmapped/unknown buildings; classification investigation required. Tier0 does not grant positive tier value; ordinary eligibility for building-based abilities does not require positive tier.
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.tooltip_zh_CN: 区域基础设施深度衡量一个区域实际拥有的普通基础设施。一至四级合格普通建筑分别提供1、2、3、4点深度，最高10点；未完成或被掠夺的建筑不计。它不是完成百分比，建满区域不一定达到10点。专业机构不计入。
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.civilopedia_detail_zh_CN: 同级多座合格普通建筑分别计入，最后封顶10；缺少低级建筑时不补齐。同领域有多个区域时，取深度最高的单一区域。内部技术载体与补偿建筑不计入。三层完整链为6，四层完整链为10；额外建筑投资可带来更高深度，不按所在规则环境归一化。
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.scale_only: Abilities specify their own coefficients; D is not a universal yield conversion.
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.semantic_definition: D measures absolute weighted eligible ordinary infrastructure actually present in a district, not relative completion or percentage of an environment-specific building system.
DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.normalization: None. A fully built district need not reach10. A normal three-tier chain1+2+3=6 and an extended four-tier chain1+2+3+4=10 are both intentionally legal. Extra infrastructure investment may produce higher D; do not normalize fully built environments to equal output.

relative_completeness.reason: Current consumers reward actual infrastructure; Military efficiency begins before full completion. Requiring completion in an extended tree would defer benefits solely because a later tier exists. No additional C, Relative D or completion percentage.
relative_completeness.reopen_condition: A specifically approved future consumer needs progress relative to its own legal building system; reopen separate Shared review then.

DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT.terminology_boundary: Formal Design display term is 区域基础设施深度. Stable concept key DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT and internal Lua/API identifiers are unchanged. Historical prose using 区域完善度 refers to this same absolute fact; future UI wording migration requires a separate task.

YIELD_SHARE.tooltip_zh_CN: 一份科技、文化、生产力、信仰或食物等于1点对应产出；一份金币等于3金币。
YIELD_SHARE.authority: Specialization-owned vocabulary, not HD function/data mapping. Only abilities expressly using shares apply this conversion.

NETWORK_LAYER.definition: Network effects do not occupy named ability slots. Specialization creates capability; domestic network propagates derived value. No mandatory shared formula and no mandatory0/1/2/3 ability count.
NETWORK_LAYER.pending_and_partial_facts: 路线拓扑PENDING／UNKNOWN时保持上次实际生效的网络派生载体，不撤除、不重写；只有相关新可靠事实才更新。已确认的身份、资格、ACTIVE、Owner／reference及REALLOCATING退出按各能力原规则优先。标准化本城／网络共用物理载体整体保持。拓扑已确认而单个来源不可读时，其它城市使用新确认事实，保留该来源仍有效的上次可靠贡献；从未可靠取得的贡献不构造。逐来源区分confirmed／retained／unknown，混合快照不冒充完整新事实，不批准新的不可逆交易。资本／发展投资原有确认、余额、收据及已签合同规则不变。
NETWORK_LAYER.cold_load_exception_A: D-1/D-2冷加载例外A仅适用于已审查的标准化合并物理载体：同一仍合格接收城市只剩无法可靠拆分的已应用组合值，部分来源已确认失效而其它必要来源事实仍未知时，暂留完整旧组合值，允许暂留失效来源的部分贡献。事实恢复后按新可靠事实重新计算并撤除失效部分；确认接收城市自身资格、Owner或reference失效立即退出。保留值不作交易凭据，不永久保存为历史；恢复由相关事实变化／可用性通知触发，不新增周期扫描。

Requalify at IV and L<E and restart full1T. Completed historical L unaffected; no Dialogue era quota or multiplier imported. D0058：读取UNKNOWN不是已确认生产中断；只复用技术机制，研习独立资格／取消／结算保持。

F_CONFIGURATION_AND_DERIVED_STATE.configuration: Commerce selected domains and activation ordinal/order persist. Capacity loss LIFO-suspends, never deletes; recovery resumes earliest selected first up to current capacity. Manual close removes; reopen newest. G_PROFESSIONAL_UNITS_AND_SOURCE_BINDING.principle: Source binding is not automatically unit lifeline. Distinguish provenance, capacity, report archive and transaction binding.
G_PROFESSIONAL_UNITS_AND_SOURCE_BINDING.Industry: Independent completed Team remains original Owner asset despite source Governor/ACTIVE/Identity/Owner changes. Permanent training-source provenance; source capacity2 counts only current Owner surviving Teams trained there. Old-owner Teams exclude new owner capacity; original-owner recapture counts its surviving old Teams again. Consumed/legally removed frees slot, living retreat does not.
G_PROFESSIONAL_UNITS_AND_SOURCE_BINDING.Commerce: Completed Reallocation Team survives training-source Governor/ACTIVE/Identity/Owner changes, no source-triggered unit transfer. Once bound, lifecycle follows REALLOCATING transaction/target; training source is provenance only. Source transfer cannot cancel another target transaction; target transfer invokes existing exceptional termination.
G_PROFESSIONAL_UNITS_AND_SOURCE_BINDING.Culture: Archive source can change only through defined E3 reattachment; source transfer does not transfer/delete unit or permit new reports to old source.
G_PROFESSIONAL_UNITS_AND_SOURCE_BINDING.direct_unit_capture: Named professional units cannot be captured or change Owner by hostile interaction; protective retreat/safe return applies, with named special lifecycle/transaction priority. Native execution is technical investigation, not a captured-ownership Gameplay TBD.

professional_unit_protection.rule: Enemies cannot capture these professional units or convert their Owner. Hostile interactions that would capture/destroy them use Great-Person-like protective retreat/safe return.
special_lifecycle_priority: REALLOCATING target Owner change dissolves its transaction-bound Team under the existing exceptional termination contract.
Expedition source Owner change cancels unfinished mission/no record, retains original unit Owner, invalidates archive binding and requires defined reattachment.
Industry source provenance/current-Owner capacity2 and original-owner recapture counting remain per-profession rules.
professional_unit_protection.technical_boundary: Native protection/retreat/safe-return interface, legal destination and reliable execution require technical investigation; captured-unit ownership is no longer Gameplay TBD. No universal rule for undiscussed units, city destruction or original Owner disappearance.

SETTLER_INVESTMENT_CONFIRMATION.before: Inspection/preparation only: Settler unconsumed, Potential unchanged, no pending investment asset.
SETTLER_INVESTMENT_CONFIRMATION.after: Confirmed action atomically consumes Settler, establishes receipt and updates Potential.
SETTLER_INVESTMENT_CONFIRMATION.technical: Internal consume/receipt/event-order window is transactional atomicity/reliable recovery, not Gameplay lifecycle TBD. No partial refund, half receipt or cross-Owner pending inheritance.

ORIGINAL_CAPITAL_SPECIAL_REFORM.scope: Future formal Design only; no current P0/P1/milestone/runtime dependency, implementation authorization or user-test requirement.

right.holder: original capital persistent city entity, once per game; not current Capital
right.relocation: Capital relocation does not transfer this right to the new capital.
right.consumption: Consume permanently only after successful Stage3 Identity switch; Stage1/2 never consume it.

stage1.success: Persist completed Stage1 until the specific pre-completion Owner-change reset.

stage2.effect: RP/institutional preparation only; no Gameplay reward
stage2.success: Persist completed Stage2 and lock the then-current legal target-specialization candidate set. Districts built later do not join this locked set.

stage3.entries: Separate target projects for Stage2 locked candidates; player chooses one. Names are placeholders.
successful_commit: Revalidate selected target district actually exists and is legal.
Switch Current Identity to the selected target.
Recompute ACTIVE from new Identity/current Governor and normal current facts.
Permanently consume the original-capital once-per-game right.

ORIGINAL_CAPITAL_SPECIAL_REFORM.ordinary_interruption: An unfinished stage is not successful and must restart its whole1T. Already successful preceding stages remain completed; Stage3 interruption does not redo Stage1/2.
ORIGINAL_CAPITAL_SPECIAL_REFORM.owner_change_before_completion: Reset entire Stage1/2 completion, locked candidates and current Stage3 transaction. If Stage3 has not successfully completed, the once-only right is unconsumed; future requalification starts Stage1 again.

stage3_target_failure.actual_absence_or_illegality: Truly removed/absent/illegal target fails completion: no Identity switch/no right consumption; completed Stage1/2 remain; choose another still-legal locked target.
stage3_target_failure.temporary_damage: Pillage or disaster temporary damage is not actual district disappearance and does not trigger this failure.

target_scope.review: Diplomatic exclusion is temporary, revisit after its future redesign; never a permanent capital-role philosophy.
target_scope.long_term_goal: If future Civic/Diplomatic and other special professions are balanced without relying on an extreme opportunity cost, original-capital special reform should in principle allow entering them normally. Diplomatic temporary exclusion is reviewed after redesign, never a permanent ban.

ORIGINAL_CAPITAL_SPECIAL_REFORM.naming: All three-stage and target-project names remain placeholders; no names locked.

ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.base_protection: 基础identity、reference、record envelope损坏沿用既有严格保护。
ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.isolation: 单个能力子记录损坏只隔离该能力，其它有效能力继续。
ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.rebuild: 能从可靠权威事实确定性重建时自动重建；不得猜补年龄、见闻、额度或已完成事务。
ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.transient: 暂时不可读、初始化未完成、读取异常或UNKNOWN不得清零／覆盖永久记录。
ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.irrecoverable: 只有已确认永久不可恢复且无其它可靠恢复证据时，允许该能力回到符合其完整结构和约束的合法零基线／初始记录；不把永久HELD或玩家手动选择作为正常最终结果。
ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.proof_before_implementation: 按能力定义可验证判据，可靠区分读取失败与持久子记录损坏。一次pcall失败、UNKNOWN、经过时间或重试次数均不是永久不可恢复证明；不能安全判定时保护原记录、报告具体受影响边界。
ABILITY_SUBRECORD_RECOVERY.diagnostics: 保留足够的限量诊断用于追查根因；不要求玩家在游戏中处理技术损坏。

FULL_TURN_PROJECT_TECHNICAL_BOUNDARY.rule: Claim、时代对话、工程传统研习保持各自资格、取消、结算及不可逆政策。只复用目标读取、状态识别、计时、完成确认及必要恢复。必须区分确认其它生产、确认空队列、读取UNKNOWN；UNKNOWN不直接取消或完成。正常读取由已验证相关城市／项目事件触发并限定范围；恢复只由可靠相关事件、事实变化、可用性恢复通知或已有必要初始化边界触发。不新增轮询、逐回合全城扫描、无依赖变化重试或用时间经过恢复UNKNOWN；缺可靠触发时报告缺口。队列多于一项时明确原因、不自动启动；其它已确认中断沿各项目原规则。

TURN_INTERVAL_RECOVERY.rule: 无法可靠确认的计龄间隔不补计；可靠事实恢复后继续正常计龄，不永久停用。UNKNOWN_INTERVAL为异常保护而非正常业务；正常场景持续出现时调查回合边界、提交与恢复传播根因。
